artifact.dc:title: The Springbok (Antidorcas marsupialis)
artifact.dc:creator: South African National Parks (SANParks)
artifact.dc:subject: Springbok; Antidorcas marsupialis; Khoisan Cosmology; National Symbol; South Africa Wildlife
artifact.dc:description: Explores the biological profile of Antidorcas marsupialis, its role in Khoisan hunting heritage, and its recognition as South Africa's national animal emblem.
